newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia to unveil corporate law changes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia to unveil corporate law changes.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday the government would announce its corporate law economic reform programme later on Tuesday.

"The government will be announcing today its corporate law economic reform programme -- a reform to re-engineer corporate law to harmonise it with the government's economic objectives," Costello told parliament.
He said the programme would involve changes to a number of areas of the law, including takeovers, fundraising, futures, security markets, directors' duties and electronic commerce.
Australian corporate law was currently viewed as too legalistic, too prescriptive and not in touch with modern commercial practice, he said.
"(We'll be) making sure that our laws are up-to-date and facilitating business," Costello said.
On Monday, Costello said a task force had recommended that fundraising, takeovers and other dealings in securities be governed by the Corporations Law, not the Trade Practices Act.
